يخترطون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَرِطُونَ (yaḵtariṭūna) /jax.ta.ri.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# يُخْتَرَطُونَ (yuḵtaraṭūna) /jux.ta.ra.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
